classes.A: INTERNAL REPO / IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT: existing machinery contradicts its current contract -> repair now (in the named task)
classes.B: TEST / PROOF GAP FOR IMPLEMENTED BEHAVIOR: qualification missing -> add test/probe; repair if it fails
classes.C: GENERICITY / SPECIAL-CASE DEFECT: production machinery depends on a commissioning specimen -> repair now (D24 proves before repairing)
classes.D: APPROVED BUT UNIMPLEMENTED CAPABILITY: keep [GAP] unless the current implemented pipeline needs it
classes.E: EXTERNAL / ENVIRONMENT LIMIT: keep the honest [GAP]/[ERR]/[UNK]
classes.G: OWNER / SEMANTIC DECISION: stop -> ASCII / owner
